thread:
marta: Heads up — flaky ordering in the browser SDK when streaming via EventSource behind our proxy. On a throttled connection chunks sometimes arrive out of order (e.g., 1,4,2,3). No error.
leo: do you have a tiny labelled log? are you seeing reconnects or parallel connections?
marta: short log snippet:
[09:04:01] seq=1 part="Start"
[09:04:03] seq=4 part="End"
[09:04:06] seq=2 part=", middle"
[09:04:07] seq=3 part=" still"
looks like final arrived early.
gabe: could be H2 frame reassembly at the proxy. under bandwidth caps frames may be flushed oddly. do you have last-event-id enabled?
marta: nope, default SDK settings, autoReconnect on. i can repro by throttling to ~100kbps. also noticed two connections briefly during reconnect backoff.
ulex: tiny suggestion: SDK should buffer events and order by a sequence token if present, then emit. also expose opt-in `reorderOnReceive` flag so apps that rely on immediate delivery can opt out.
leo: server/runtime could add a monotonic seq in the SSE `id:` or a custom `X-Chunk-Seq` header to make this deterministic.
gabe: short mitigation: set `enableAutoReconnect:false` in the SDK or increase `reconnectDelayMs` to avoid overlapping connections. but long-term we should add reorder/dedupe and an observability metric when out-of-order is detected.
udx-bot: filed infra ticket #5120 "streaming: provide chunk sequence header + browser-sdk reorder option" and linked to sampleapp test.
marta: i'll add a repro in sampleapp that runs through a local proxy with h2 frame-split simulation and post a PR. thanks! :thumbsup:
